chunks: Und von ihm, von Muhammad ibn Hammam, der sagte: Ahmad ibn Bundar überlieferte uns von Mansur ibn al-Abbas, von Ja'far al-Jawhari, von Zakariyya ibn Adam al-Qummi, von al-Rida (Friede sei mit ihm), der sagte:
Wahrlich, Allah bewahrte Bagdad aufgrund der Lage der beiden Gräber der Al-Husayns darin.
ai.seo_question: Warum wurde Bagdad gerettet wurde nach Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (Imam Musa al-Kadhim's son, often used for Imam Ali al-Rida) is a title of the eighth Shia Imam, Ali ibn Musa. The term is often used to refer to him specifically. The preservation of Baghdad from divine calamities is attributed to the presence of the tombs of the two Al-Husayns, specifically referring to Imam al-Husayn (AS) and his son Ali ibn Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin), whose shrines are located in the city. This narration underscores the Shia belief in the intercessory power and spiritual barakah of the Ahl al-Bayt's resting places, serving as a source of protection and mercy for the communities that honor them.
